verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence describes a first-run or onboarding wizard. Setup is documented as Docker, npm or Helm installs, with model and endpoint configuration done in librechat.yaml and .env files. The browser-based Admin Panel and the runtime MCP Settings panel are adjacent configuration UIs, not a guided first-run flow through credentials, channels and defaults, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a first-run wizard walks me through model credentials, channels, and defaults instead of hand-editing config files
